name: Snips & Snails
source: Snips & Snails is an 18+ Otome game featuring four love interests of different supernatural species referred to as the Arcane, or Arcs. Play as a college aged girl just trying to figure out her life while also forming new friendships and relationships with a local Arcane family. Experience the butterfly effect by choosing a different path for the MC each time and see how different her life becomes due to your choices! The person you fall for can really change your life, in many big ways. Experience the ups and downs of relationships told in a short-story format!
translation: Snips & Snails是一款适合18岁以上的乙女游戏，其中包含四种不同超自然物种（称为奥术或弧线）的爱情兴趣。扮演一名大学女孩，试图弄清楚自己的生活，同时与当地的奥术家庭建立新的友谊和关系。每次为MC选择不同的路径，体验蝴蝶效应，看看她的生活因你的选择而变得多么不同！你爱上的人确实可以在很多方面改变你的生活。体验以短篇故事形式讲述的人际关系的酸甜苦辣！
